2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032774' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '009' will be updated on the next run
ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032739' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '020' will be deleted from the source on the next run
ENTITY_ID = 'PA1133181' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '008' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed
ENTITY_ID = 'TEST_INSERT' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table)

EDS.DEP_ITCP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032739' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '020'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
EDS.DEP_ITCP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1133181' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '008'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
EDS.DEP_ITCP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'TEST_INSERT' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001'


3. Run scripts to fabricate updated, deleted , new record and update filename date

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP] SET PREF_REMARKS = 'UPD_TEST123'
WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032774' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '009' AND H = 'D';

WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032739' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '020' AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20180423','20180426');

(H,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,ENTITY_TYPE,PREF_TYPE,PREF_SUB_TYPE,START_DATE,END_DATE,PREF_RATE_CODE,PREF_RATE_PCNT,PREF_REMARKS,CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm)
SELECT 'D','TEST_INSERT' ENTITY_ID,'001'  INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,ENTITY_TYPE,PREF_TYPE,PREF_SUB_TYPE,START_DATE,END_DATE,PREF_RATE_CODE,PREF_RATE_PCNT,PREF_REMARKS,CONS_FOR_EFF_PREF,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP]  
WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1133181' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '008' AND H = 'D';


SELECT FILE_NAME,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032774' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '009'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1032739' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '020'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
